_comment: Adept powers catalogue (SR4A p.195-197, SM p.174-180, DG p.17-18, WAR, WotA p.14-15). mode: passive = permanent bonus; situational = bonus only in a given circumstance; toggle = activated (see action); roll = a test is made when used (see test). cost is PP per level when perLevel else flat; costByLevel overrides; maxLevel 'Magic' = adept's Magic. bonus[] items: type attr|skill|derived|pool, target, value (x level if perLevel or implicit for perLevel powers). Source supplements/magic files 05,22,23,24,30.

powers.name: Astral Perception
powers.note: Perceive the astral plane (dual-natured perception, astral perception rules p.191).

powers.name: Attribute Boost
powers.note: Per Physical attribute (Agility, Body, Reaction, Strength). Hits = +attribute for 2 x hits Combat Turns; resist Drain = rating (Willpower + Body, Stun).

powers.name: Combat Sense
powers.note: +1 die/level to Reaction on Surprise tests and when defending vs ranged and melee.

powers.name: Critical Strike
powers.note: +1 DV/level to unarmed damage (and astral combat).

powers.name: Enhanced Perception
powers.note: +1 die/level on Perception tests incl. Assensing, max Intuition.

powers.name: Great Leap
powers.note: +1 die/level to Jumping tests and +level to Agility for jump distance.

powers.name: Improved Ability
powers.note: +1/level to one active skill (not group); max 1.5 x base rating. 0.5 PP/level for Combat skills, 0.25 for Physical/Social/Technical/Vehicle.

powers.name: Improved Physical Attribute
powers.note: +1/level to Agility, Body, Reaction or Strength. Over natural max costs 1.5 PP/level. Reaction also affects Initiative.

powers.name: Improved Reflexes
powers.note: +1 Reaction and +1 Initiative Pass per level (max 3). Not combinable with tech/other magical IP.

powers.name: Improved Sense
powers.note: One sense improvement per purchase (low-light, thermographic, hearing ranges, direction sense, improved scent/taste, flare comp., sound damping).

powers.name: Killing Hands
powers.note: Unarmed attacks may deal Physical instead of Stun; works vs Immunity to Normal Weapons and in astral combat.

powers.name: Kinesics
powers.note: +1/level on Social tests made/resisted and on truthfulness/emotion tests; silent code with other Kinesics adepts.

powers.name: Missile Parry
powers.test: Reaction + Missile Parry (+Dodge on full defense)
powers.note: Catch slow missiles; need at least equal hits to the ranged attack.

powers.name: Mystic Armor
powers.note: +1 Ballistic and Impact armor per level, cumulative with worn armor; also in astral combat.

powers.name: Natural Immunity
powers.note: +1 die/level to resist toxins and diseases.

powers.name: Pain Resistance
powers.note: Subtract level from current damage before wound modifiers; +2 dice/level vs pain effects.

powers.name: Rapid Healing
powers.note: +1 die/level to Body for Healing Tests.

powers.name: Spell Resistance
powers.note: +1 die/level to resist spells (and Innate Spell/Spellcasting by critters).

powers.name: Voice Control
powers.test: Con + Charisma vs recognition / Perception + Intuition
powers.note: Mimic voices/sounds; throw the voice up to Magic x 2 m.

powers.name: Analytics
powers.note: +1 die/level to pattern recognition, evidence analysis, puzzles.

powers.name: Animal Empathy
powers.note: +1 die/level handling non-sapient animals.

powers.name: Berserk
powers.note: +1 all Physical, -1 all Mental (min 1) for Magic minutes.

powers.name: Blind Fighting
powers.note: Full-darkness penalty -4 instead of -6.

powers.name: Cloak
powers.note: +level dice vs active Detection spells / Search power.

powers.name: Commanding Voice
powers.note: Command of 5 words or fewer; extra targets give +1 each (max +5).

powers.name: Cool Resolve
powers.note: +level dice to opposed Social tests where the adept defends.

powers.name: Counterstrike
powers.note: After a successful parry/block add level + net hits of the defense to the next melee attack.

powers.name: Distance Strike
powers.note: Unarmed attack up to Magic metres; no Reach; not with Elemental Strike.

powers.name: Eidetic Sense Memory
powers.note: Perfect memory of all senses.

powers.name: Elemental Strike
powers.note: Requires Killing Hands; adds an elemental effect for Magic Combat Turns; not with Distance Strike.

powers.name: Empathic Healing
powers.note: Transfer 1 box Physical damage per hit from target to adept.

powers.name: Enthralling Performance
powers.note: Hits become threshold modifier for audience Perception; one skill per purchase.

powers.name: Facial Sculpt
powers.note: +level dice to Disguise; reshape face for Magic hours.

powers.name: Flexibility
powers.note: +level dice to Escape Artist.

powers.name: Freefall
powers.note: Effective fall distance reduced by 2 m/level.

powers.name: Gliding
powers.note: Run up to Magic metres across surfaces that cannot bear weight; -3 dice for acrobatics.

powers.name: Inertia Strike
powers.note: Add half Strength to damage boxes for Knockdown only.

powers.name: Iron Gut
powers.note: +level dice vs ingested toxins.

powers.name: Iron Lungs
powers.note: +10 Combat Turns holding breath/level; +level dice to fatigue tests.

powers.name: Iron Will
powers.note: +level dice vs magical mind control.

powers.name: Linguistics
powers.note: Learn a language rating 1 after (10 - Magic) hours of exposure.

powers.name: Living Focus
powers.note: Sustain one self-spell (Force <= Magic) with -2 dice to all actions.

powers.name: Magic Sense
powers.note: Senses magic within Magic x 10 m (as Detect Magic, Force = Magic).

powers.name: Melanin Control
powers.note: Alter hair/skin color for Magic hours.

powers.name: Metabolic Control
powers.note: Trance slowing metabolism by Magic factor; auto at overflow.

powers.name: Missile Mastery
powers.note: +1 DV to non-explosive thrown weapons.

powers.name: Motion Sense
powers.note: Detect moving things within Magic metres; visibility modifiers -2.

powers.name: Multi-Tasking
powers.note: Observe in Detail is a Free Action; two Free Actions per pass out of combat.

powers.name: Nerve Strike
powers.note: Each net hit -1 Agility or Reaction (1 pt regained/minute).

powers.name: Nimble Fingers
powers.note: +1 die to Palming; small object manipulations are Free Actions.

powers.name: Pain Relief
powers.note: Heal Stun boxes = net hits on another.

powers.name: Penetrating Strike
powers.note: AP -level on unarmed strikes (max 3).

powers.name: Piercing Senses
powers.note: +level dice to resist Illusion spells and illusion powers.

powers.name: Power Throw
powers.note: +2 Strength/level for thrown range and damage.

powers.name: Quick Draw
powers.note: Draw and attack in one action with any weapon.

powers.name: Rooting
powers.note: +level to Body vs knockdown; no dodge, -3 to parry/block.

powers.name: Smashing Blow
powers.note: Base DV x2 vs barriers/structures.

powers.name: Sustenance
powers.note: 3 h sleep + one meal = 8 h sleep + 3 meals.

powers.name: Temperature Tolerance
powers.note: +level dice vs heat/cold and elemental fire/cold magic.

powers.name: Three-Dimensional Memory
powers.note: Memorize areas up to Magic x Magic m3.

powers.name: Traceless Walk
powers.note: No traces or noise; hearing detection -4.

powers.name: Wall Running
powers.note: Hits = metres climbed; Gymnastics -2 during it.

powers.name: Elemental Resistance
powers.note: Requires Mystic Armor; full rating vs one elemental attack type.

powers.name: Heightened Concentration
powers.note: Ignore one situational negative modifier up to Magic.

powers.name: Memory Displacement
powers.note: Remove a chosen group of memories for a time.

powers.name: Power Swimming
powers.note: Double swimming rate; +2 m per hit.

powers.name: Supernatural Toughness
powers.note: +1 Physical or Stun box per level.

powers.name: Indomitable Will
powers.note: +level dice vs Intimidation and fear powers/spells.

powers.name: Mind Over Matter
powers.note: Use one Mental attribute in place of one Physical (fixed at purchase).

powers.name: Rush
powers.note: +1 Initiative Pass for the turn; resist Physical Drain = 2 x IPs that turn (Willpower + Body).

powers.name: Confidence Man
powers.test: Charisma + Leadership vs ally's test threshold
powers.note: Speaker's Way: ally moves one column up the Buying Hits table.

powers.name: Creative Eye
powers.note: Artist's Way: +1 Intuition/level.

powers.name: Keen Wits
powers.note: Artisan's Way: +1 Logic/level.

powers.name: Natural Survivors
powers.note: Totem's Way: +1/level to Navigation/Survival/Tracking or Shadowing/Survival/Street Knowledge.

powers.name: Prodigious Physicality
powers.note: Athlete's Way: +1/level to Climbing, Gymnastics, Running or Swimming.

powers.name: Sorcerous Parry
powers.note: Magician's Way: +1 Counterspelling rating/level (max 1.5 x base).

powers.name: Swift and Terrible
powers.note: Warrior's Way: +1 Initiative per enemy beaten in close combat (limit = levels), next round only.

powers.name: Unseen Hands
powers.note: Invisible Way: +1/level to Disguise, Infiltration, Palming or Shadowing.
